name: PR416 final-head focused validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-final-head-7cc
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-final-head-focused.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  detector:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 7cc7d868f38096754cc85758b9224fb2c34fb5b8
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run permanent InPoss detector
        run: |
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=sim_match_engine_inposs_gate" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

  tackle:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 7cc7d868f38096754cc85758b9224fb2c34fb5b8
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run tackle regression and save-restore locks
        run: |
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed|Name=BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose|Name=TacklesHappenInComposedPlay|Name=ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice|Name=SaveAndRestoreCarryTheTackleLatches" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

  perception-ball:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 7cc7d868f38096754cc85758b9224fb2c34fb5b8
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run Perception and Ball Physics locks
        run: |
          dotnet test src/perception-system/Tests/perception-system-tests.gen.csproj --no-restore --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"
          dotnet test src/ball-physics/tests/ball-physics-tests.gen.csproj --no-restore --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"
